narrative.northStar: A compact studio signal in Matari lime and pixel type.
narrative.overview: RELAY carries the live Matari Audio Signal identity into its plugin and browser listener. Its tiny card and editor are instruments: readable fields, a clear action, honest meters and a live dot with two outgoing chevrons. Pixel is the default; the editor saves a Standard font and corner option.
keyCharacteristics: Silkscreen headings with Departure Mono body and values
Saved Standard editor choice: Barlow and Martian Mono
Content-sized browser card that shrinks cleanly in Firefox
Original staggered spring logo motion with reduced-motion support

rules.name: One signal
rules.body: Lime marks action, selection, live status and the logo; yellow and red show hotter levels or errors.

rules.name: Readable pixels
rules.body: Use pixel type at readable sizes and shorten labels before shrinking the whole card.

rules.name: Keep the meters
rules.body: Do not let changelog, controls or long room labels push the fixed meter column out of the editor.

dos: Keep the dot and two chevrons in both plugin and browser.
Keep the listener list and per-listener sliders usable at 380×150.
donts: Do not use the old green #1fe06a as the action color.
Do not stretch the listen card across the viewport.
